name: openbb_institutional_ownership
description:
Institutional ownership summary for one stock from 13F data through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.ownership.institutional).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, truncated, holders: [records per filing date with investor counts, shares, ownership percent]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp; default fmp).
Named holders without a key: yf_institutional_holders, yf_mutual_fund_holders. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
